scope: Schema and preprocessing policy only; H1 does not fabricate a Stage 3 dataset.

record_fields.geometry_id: stable geometry identity, unique within dataset
record_fields.sample_id: stable surface sample identity within geometry
record_fields.length_unit: declared unit; converted to m at validation boundary
record_fields.triangle_count: integer or null for point-cloud-only records
record_fields.point_count: integer or null for mesh-only records
record_fields.normal_orientation: orientation method, reference direction, and confidence
record_fields.random_seed: integer or null for deterministic preprocessing
record_fields.geometry_hash: SHA256 of canonical source bytes and transform manifest

mesh_contract.watertight_requirement: Required for volumetric/inside-outside operations; not required for surface-only coverage if explicitly declared.
mesh_contract.normal_requirement: Normals required after preprocessing; source normals may be replaced only with provenance.
mesh_contract.units: Source unit is mandatory; canonical internal unit is m.
mesh_contract.frame: Frame name and source-to-frame transform are mandatory.
mesh_contract.degenerate_triangle_handling: Reject zero-area triangles from coverage sampling and report count; never silently repair into area.
mesh_contract.duplicate_vertex_handling: Deduplicate only with a declared metric tolerance and record the pre/post counts.
mesh_contract.mesh_repair_policy: No automatic repair in H1; H2 may add versioned repair steps with before/after hashes and a human-readable report.
mesh_contract.sampling_policy: Area-weighted triangle sampling with deterministic seed for coverage; exact triangle IDs and barycentric coordinates are recorded.

point_cloud_contract.point_format: XYZ or XYZRGB/XYZ normal extension with an explicit schema
point_cloud_contract.xyz_units: Mandatory source unit; canonical internal unit is m.
point_cloud_contract.normal_optional_required: Optional on input; required after deterministic normal estimation before normal-sensitive validation.
point_cloud_contract.downsampling: Voxel or uniform sampling with voxel size/sample budget recorded; never use an unrecorded default.
point_cloud_contract.outlier_removal: Disabled unless a versioned rule, threshold, retained/rejected counts, and seed are recorded.
point_cloud_contract.normal_estimation: Declared neighborhood size/search method, implementation version, and seed if applicable.
point_cloud_contract.orientation: Orient normals using a declared viewpoint/reference field; sign flips are recorded.
point_cloud_contract.registration: Registration transform, algorithm, convergence, inlier count, and source/target hashes are mandatory; no registration is assumed.

canonicalization.hashing: SHA256 over canonical source bytes plus ordered transform/preprocessing manifest
canonicalization.ordering: Stable lexical geometry_id and sample_id order; no filesystem iteration order
canonicalization.nonfinite_values: Reject NaN and infinity before hashing
canonicalization.missing_geometry: Fail closed for a required record; do not create placeholder samples
